t: The Nebo Torchy 2K is a powerful and compact rechargeable LED flashlight, delivering 2000 lumens for reliable portable lighting. Ideal for demanding site work, workshop inspections, and general maintenance tasks, this durable work light features an impact-resistant aluminium body and IPX6 water resistance, ensuring performance in challenging conditions. Its integrated Li-Ion battery offers 3.5 hours run time, easily recharged via MagDock USB or USB-C. Five light modes, including strobe, are managed by Smart Power Control, providing versatile illumination. A detachable 2-way clip allows for convenient hands-free operation.
